native_custom_check_ledger.native_title: Raffle state-changing entry points with external interactions are nonReentrant (except documented allowlist)
All quote-token safeTransfer calls are inside _transferQuote
Per-raffle configuration variables are written only by initialize()
fulfillRandomWords: no explicit revert/require/assert, no external interaction, no loop
Prize transfers only in redeem/releaseSponsorPrize, each reads+writes prizeClaimed and verifies ownerOf
Raffle._update screens destinations via _isProtocolDestination and delegates to ERC721._update
createRaffle: clone -> initialize -> register(isRaffle) -> untrusted prize safeTransferFrom
_transferQuote recipients are sponsorRecipient/protocolTreasury (fixed) or the authenticated owner

scope_corrections: S6-F1 one-block-early VRF/marketplace exploit assertion is not established by the mock test; the operator chooses word7 and manually pranks the transferor. Keep LEAD-001 unproved external-ordering preconditions.

The45-property ledger is not45 universal proofs. SM-3/SM-12/EI-2 require truthful prize behavior; ownerOf checking cannot prove actual delivery for malicious tokens. T-3 only screens current protocol code and can become false at a later future-clone address.
EI-1 wording every value-moving entry point nonReentrant is broader than custom C1, whose explicit allowlist includes inherited ticket transfers/callbacks. Do not discard that allowlist.
ST-1 passing Slither interface checks is not complete ERC721 standards conformance. Missing repository tests/scripts in an intentionally source-only context is not proof the repository lacks them.

Native TP-accepted Slither statuses and action-plan acceptance are reviewer triage, never current owner acceptance. No sponsor-capping redesign or payout gate is an approved fix; complete both-bucket liability/fallback analysis is required.

Before final campaign, the native harness corrected settle-on-redeem cash winnerProceeds expectation and a nonpayable assertion constructor. These retained failures are test artifacts, not production defects.

Echidna/Medusa use two raffles/four actors; ordinary entry counts1..25 plus buyHuge, refund batches<=8 with corruption modes, bounded warps. Full100-ticket batches, dishonest prize-delivery verification branches and wrapper paidPrice>msg.value were not universally exercised. No Manticore execution; disclosed Halmos substitution.
